The FX5U CPU module models are as follows:
AC power supply models:

FX5U-32MR/ES (16 inputs, 16 relay outputs)
FX5U-32MT/ES (16 inputs, 16 transistor sink outputs)
FX5U-32MT/ESS (16 inputs, 16 transistor source outputs)
FX5U-64MR/ES (32 inputs, 32 relay outputs)
FX5U-64MT/ES (32 inputs, 32 transistor sink outputs)
FX5U-64MT/ESS (32 inputs, 32 transistor source outputs)
FX5U-80MR/ES (40 inputs, 40 relay outputs)
FX5U-80MT/ES (40 inputs, 40 transistor sink outputs)
FX5U-80MT/ESS (40 inputs, 40 transistor source outputs)

DC power supply models:

FX5U-32MR/DS (16 inputs, 16 relay outputs)
FX5U-32MT/DS (16 inputs, 16 transistor sink outputs)
FX5U-32MT/DSS (16 inputs, 16 transistor source outputs)
FX5U-64MR/DS (32 inputs, 32 relay outputs)
FX5U-64MT/DS (32 inputs, 32 transistor sink outputs)
FX5U-64MT/DSS (32 inputs, 32 transistor source outputs)
FX5U-80MR/DS (40 inputs, 40 relay outputs)
FX5U-80MT/DS (40 inputs, 40 transistor sink outputs)
FX5U-80MT/DSS (40 inputs, 40 transistor source outputs)

The naming convention follows this pattern:

The number (32/64/80) indicates the total number of I/O points
MR indicates relay outputs
MT indicates transistor outputs
ES indicates AC power supply
DS indicates DC power supply
ESS indicates AC power supply with source type transistor outputs
DSS indicates DC power supply with source type transistor outputs

queries.question: Can you tell me about the communication ports in FX5U-32MT/ES?
queries.our_answer:
The FX5U-32MT/ES, as an FX5U CPU module, is equipped with the following built-in communication ports:

*   **Ethernet Port**
    *   **Availability:** Applicable to FX5U CPU modules [Source 9].
    *   **Functions:** Supports connection with MELSOFT products and GOT, socket communications, file transfer (FTP server, FTP client), Web server (HTTP), SNTP client, and simple CPU communication [Source 7].

*   **RS-485 Port**
    *   **Availability:** Applicable to FX5U CPU modules [Source 9].
    *   **Specifications:**
        *   **Transmission Standards:** Conforms to RS-485/RS-422 specifications [Source 5].
        *   **Data Transmission Speed:** Maximum 115.2 kbps [Source 5].
        *   **Communication Method:** Full-duplex (FDX) / Half-duplex (HDX) [Source 5].
        *   **Maximum Total Extension Distance:** 50 m [Source 5].
        *   **Protocol Types:** MELSOFT connection, Non-protocol communication, MELSEC communication protocol (1C/3C/4C frames), MODBUS RTU, Predefined protocol support, Inverter communication, N:N network, Parallel link [Source 5].
        *   **Insulation Method:** Not insulated [Source 5].
        *   **Terminal Resistors:** Built-in (OPEN/110 Ω /330 Ω) [Source 5].
        *   **Terminal Block Used:** European-type terminal block [Source 5].
    *   **Functions:** Related to serial communications such as N:N Network, parallel link, MC protocol, inverter communication function, and non-protocol communication. It also supports MODBUS communication for connection with products supporting MODBUS RTU/TCP, functioning as both master and slave [Source 7].

*   **USB Port**
    *   **Availability:** A built-in USB (Mini-B) connector is **not applicable** to the FX5U CPU module [Source 9].
